_README: Claude Startup Kit — user config. Edit the user copy at ~/.claude/scripts/startup-kit-config.json. The installer copies this default file ONLY when no user config exists; subsequent installs preserve your customizations.

window._adaptive_help: When true, cols/lines/fontSize are computed from the screen resolution. Set false to lock to the values below.

selfUpdate._repoPath_help: Absolute path to the cloned claude-startup-kit repo. Set this to enable self-update.
